title: Begin again
task: Help a beginner resume a creative practice after a missed day without streak pressure.
notice: Exploratory ideas, not built prototypes or cultural studies. Human review unrecorded.

synthesis.title: Thread Pickup: resume from a chosen unfinished stitch
synthesis.action: User picks a resume point and step size via arrow keys, drag, or tap.
synthesis.feedback: Suggestion labeled 'my guess, unsure' with spoken confidence; one-tap correct or undo.
synthesis.mechanism: Explicit states: paused, reattached, corrected; never broken. Corrections retune later suggestions.
synthesis.difference: Continuity counts reattached threads, not consecutive days; uncertainty is shown openly and invites correction.
synthesis.risks: Guesses may feel presumptuous; confidence wording could confuse; users may overpick effort.
synthesis.feasibility: Single offline HTML page, local fictional notes, rule-based guessing, undo stack.
synthesis.prototype: Keyboard-accessible mockup with aria-live announcements; observe correction rate and resume attempts, untested.

proposals.title: Warm Ember Restart
proposals.action: User drags ember slider to pick tiny restart session length.
proposals.feedback: Ember glows; app shows guess labeled as editable estimate.
proposals.mechanism: App suggests restart size from fictional history, user corrects freely.
proposals.difference: No streak counter; momentum shown as fading warmth, never zeroed.
proposals.risks: Estimates may feel judgmental; uncertainty labels could confuse beginners.
proposals.feasibility: Local storage web prototype with fictional sample data only.
proposals.prototype: Clickable offline mockup testing slider, estimate label, and correction.

proposals.title: Bookmark Thread: resume where your hands left off
proposals.action: User drags a loose thread onto last saved sketch moment.
proposals.feedback: Thread shows 'gap noted, not judged' with editable guessed reason.
proposals.mechanism: Explicit resume-state machine: paused, reattached, corrected, never broken.
proposals.difference: Replaces streak counters with a reattachable continuity thread.
proposals.risks: Guessed reasons may feel presumptuous; uncertainty labels must stay visible.
proposals.feasibility: Single offline page with local fictional data and undo stack.
proposals.prototype: Static HTML mock with state log and one-tap correction.

proposals.title: Re-entry Dial
proposals.action: User turns a dial choosing tonight's effort: two, five, or ten minutes.
proposals.feedback: App shows a guessed-fit label marked 'my guess', which the user can correct.
proposals.mechanism: Correctable effort guess replaces streak count; user corrections retune future suggestions.
proposals.difference: No streak; the app shows its uncertainty openly and asks to be corrected.
proposals.risks: Guesses may feel patronizing; users may ignore corrections or overpick effort.
proposals.feasibility: Local storage, fictional sample sessions, simple rule-based guessing; buildable offline.
proposals.prototype: Clickable offline mockup; observe whether beginners correct guesses and resume.

proposals.title: Thread Pickup: resume from your last unfinished stitch
proposals.action: User chooses one tiny re-entry step from last session's note.
proposals.feedback: Shows 'likely good restart' with stated confidence, user can correct.
proposals.mechanism: Keyboard-navigable thread of past notes; arrow keys pick resume point.
proposals.difference: No streaks; continuity measured by resumed threads, not consecutive days.
proposals.risks: Guesses may feel presumptuous; screen readers need clear uncertainty phrasing.
proposals.feasibility: Single offline HTML page with local fictional sample notes.
proposals.prototype: Tab-traversable list, editable suggestion, aria-live confidence and undo announcements.

synthesis.title: Rejoin Thread
synthesis.action: User picks one small saved prompt and ties it to their last session.
synthesis.feedback: Join shows gap neutrally; user sets readiness as sure, unsure, or unknown, editable anytime.
synthesis.mechanism: Gaps are neutral pauses; user-rated confidence directly sizes today's suggested session, correctable before starting.
synthesis.difference: No counters or loss; uncertainty changes session size instead of decorating it.
synthesis.risks: Thread metaphor may still imply breakage; beginners may find confidence rating effortful.
synthesis.feasibility: Single offline HTML page, local storage, fictional sessions and prompts.
synthesis.prototype: Clickable mock with three prompts, confidence picker, and undo; needs beginner walkthroughs, untested.

proposals.title: Mend Thread
proposals.action: User ties a visible knot linking last session to today.
proposals.feedback: Knot shows gap honestly; tightness reflects user-rated confidence, editable.
proposals.mechanism: Sessions bind like stitched joints; gaps become labeled, repairable seams.
proposals.difference: Gaps are visible repairs, not broken streaks or reset counters.
proposals.risks: Seam imagery may still feel like failure to some.
proposals.feasibility: Single offline page, local storage, fictional sample sessions.
proposals.prototype: Paper or HTML mock: thread timeline, knot editor, undo control.

proposals.title: Reservoir Refill Sketchbook
proposals.action: User pours small practice sessions into a fictional creative reservoir.
proposals.feedback: Water level rises gradually; missed days show slow evaporation, not reset.
proposals.mechanism: Stock-and-flow model with lagged inflow and visible uncertainty mist.
proposals.difference: Replaces streak counters with forgiving levels and adjustable leak rates.
proposals.risks: Metaphor may confuse; evaporation could still feel like quiet guilt.
proposals.feasibility: Simple offline web app using local storage and fictional sessions.
proposals.prototype: Paper or HTML mockup with draggable level and correction slider.

proposals.title: Re-entrance Stage: Practice Steps Back On
proposals.action: User drags a performer token from wings onto a small stage.
proposals.feedback: Stage shows tentative spotlight size reflecting guessed readiness, labeled uncertain.
proposals.mechanism: Proximity to center sets session length; user adjusts freely anytime.
proposals.difference: Missed days become offstage pauses, not broken streak counters.
proposals.risks: Theatrical metaphor may confuse; guesses could feel presumptuous.
proposals.feasibility: Single offline HTML page with local fictional session data.
proposals.prototype: Paper sketch plus clickable mockup; untested, needs beginner walkthroughs.

proposals.title: Supply Cache Restart
proposals.action: User picks one small stored sketch prompt to repair today.
proposals.feedback: Cache shows prompts as rations, marked fresh, unsure, or user-corrected.
proposals.mechanism: Missed days stock the cache instead of breaking a chain.
proposals.difference: Gaps become stored supplies, not lost streak points.
proposals.risks: Rationing metaphor may feel scarce or confusing to beginners.
proposals.feasibility: Offline local list with fictional prompts and editable confidence labels.
proposals.prototype: Paper or HTML mock with three prompts and user relabeling.
